name: University of Stirling
description: Stirling is an international university that welcomes the world with proud Scottish hospitality. Thinking and working globally is part of our daily teaching and research practice. We’ve partnerships with over 70 universities worldwide while the contribution from our international students and staff from all over the world is crucial to our continued success and global outlook. We offer our students experiences of a lifetime through our Study Abroad program and we prepare our students to thrive as global citizens in an increasingly connected world. Timestamps Updated
